vulnerability_analysis: The NowMeta contract has an owner-only function setMaxTxAmount() that controls the maximum transaction amount. When set to 0, the require(amount <= maxTxAmount) check in _transfer() will fail for any amount > 0, effectively locking all user funds. This is a classic owner privilege abuse where the owner can freeze all transfers.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxTxAmount(0) to set the maximum transaction amount to zero, which will block all transfers.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Identify the current owner address
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call setMaxTxAmount(0) on the target contract
4. Verify that maxTxAmount is now 0
